{{Color box|{{party color|Lakas–CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas–CMD|Lakas]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Zambales's 1st congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Zambales]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 10, 2021}} The district consists of the city of [[Olongapo]] and adjacent municipalities in the southernmost part of Zambales, namely [[Castillejos]], [[San Marcelino, Zambales|San Marcelino]] and [[Subic, Zambales|Subic]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 10, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Jay Khonghun|Jefferson F. Khonghun]] of the [[Sulong Zambales Party]] (SZP) and [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 10, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
